agent_context.content: Replying to all relevant x posts
I'll help you create a system to efficiently reply to relevant X (Twitter) posts. Let me research the current best practices and tools for managing X interactions at scale.

[web_search result for "best tools 2024 manage reply to tweets X Twitter automation engagement"]:


Sources: https://sproutsocial.com/insights/twitter-automation/, https://www.youtube.com/watch%3Fv%3DwOqxqb8rXbk, https://www.reddit.com/r/automation/comments/1hgvz0r/how_to_automate_twitter_posts/, https://statusbrew.com/learn/twitter-management-tools/, https://www.dansiepen.io/saas-stack/twitter-tools

The goal is to reply to all relevant X posts. This is a broad goal and requires clarification on several fronts. I need to understand what constitutes a 'relevant' post, what kind of 'reply' is expected, and what 'all' entails (e.g., historical posts, ongoing monitoring, specific accounts, keywords). Since I am in the PLAN phase and the goal is not yet clear enough to form a concrete plan, I need to ask clarifying questions.

1. Relevant = mentions of “SaaSOptics” (our brand), “subscription revenue recognition,” “ARR metrics,” or the #SaaSfinance hashtag. Also any tweet that tags @SaaSOptics or DM’s us.

2. Reply style: friendly expert tone, 1–2 sentences, add a helpful stat or link to our latest playbook (https://saasoptics.com/arr-playbook). No hard sell. Sign with “–Megan on the SaaSOptics team.”

3. Scope: every new mention from 7 a.m.–7 p.m. ET, Mon–Fri. Cap at 25 replies/day so we don’t trigger limits. If we hit 25, queue the rest for next morning.

4. Yep, account is @SaaSOptics. I’ll paste the API keys in the secure field once we start.

5. We use Sprout now, but their keyword search misses a lot, so I’m looking to replace or supplement it—CSV export of replies for Sprout is fine so I can keep the unified inbox.

Plan ready – will build a lightweight X-reply engine that:

1. Monitors the four keyword/hashtag streams plus @SaaSOptics mentions and DMs via X API v2 filtered stream.
2. Runs 7 a.m.–7 p.m. ET, Mon–Fri only; auto-pause outside those windows.
3. Replies with your friendly, expert tone using your template, signs “–Megan on the SaaSOptics team.”
3. Enforces 25-reply daily cap; excess are queued for next open window.
4. Logs everything in a CSV export formatted for Sprout import so you keep your unified inbox.

I’ll need the four API keys (consumer key/secret, access token/secret) and your desired CSV export cadence (daily/weekly). Ready to proceed with a Python script + free GitHub Actions scheduler.

Please confirm these details before I finalize the plan.

This looks great! Yes, let's proceed.

For the API keys, I'll send them over in a separate, secure message.

For the CSV export, daily would be perfect.

Plan confirmed. Daily CSV export, 25-reply cap, 7 a.m.–7 p.m. ET Mon–Fri window, friendly expert tone with playbook link, signed –Megan on the SaaSOptics team. Ready to build the Python script and GitHub Actions scheduler once API keys arrive.
